twoFactor.title: Two-factor code
twoFactor.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each works once.
twoFactor.useCode: Use a code from the app

chooseTenant.title: Choose an organization
chooseTenant.hint: You belong to several. Which one do you want to work in?

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.hint: We'll email you a link to choose a new password.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.signUp: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in here.
checkEmail.forgot: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent it a link to choose a new password. It opens in your browser; then sign in here.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.captcha: This server asks for a bot check that the app can't show yet. Ask its administrator, or sign in on the web.
errors.offline: You're offline. Changes are sent when you're back.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.unverifiedHint: Tap to send the link again.

language.title: Language
language.restart: Close and reopen the app to switch the layout direction.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: Where your account is signed in: browsers and apps.
sessions.everywhereBody: Every browser and app signed in to your account, this one included, will be signed out.

notificationSettings.title: Notifications
notificationSettings.hint: In the app you always get every notification. Choose what also comes by email, and how often.
notificationSettings.mandatory: Required: email can be bundled, not switched off.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.on: Push and text messages wait from {{start}} to {{end}} ({{timezone}}), except urgent ones.
quietHours.off: Off: push and text messages arrive at any time.

notes.title: Title
notes.deleteBody: "{{title}}" is moved to the deleted notes; an administrator can restore it.
notes.conflict: Someone else changed this note since you opened it. Load their version, then make your change again.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.signInAgain: Your account signs in with a link or another provider, which this app can't ask for here. Sign out and sign in again, then try once more.

password.signInAgain: You were signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.

mfa.title: Two-factor
mfa.offHint: Two-factor asks for a code from an authenticator app when you sign in, so a stolen password isn't enough.
mfa.addHint: Add this account to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
mfa.noApp: No authenticator app opened. Copy the key instead.
mfa.orKey: Or enter this key in the app:
mfa.recoveryHint: Each signs you in once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.
mfa.turnOffBody: Signing in will ask only for your password.

yourData.title: Your data
yourData.exportHint: Everything your account holds, as a file. It takes a moment; the link lasts 30 minutes.
yourData.newVersion: A new version: please agree again.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.hint: Your account and your data are deleted for good.
deleteAccount.graceHint: Nothing happens at once: you can cancel during the waiting period, here or from the email we send.
deleteAccount.scheduled: Your account will be deleted on {{date}}.
deleteAccount.pendingHint: Your other sign-ins were signed out. Until then you can cancel.

records.noTagsDefined: No tags exist for this kind of record yet.

revisions.restoreBody: Its values become the current ones; the history keeps every version.

attachments.title: Files
attachments.tooLarge: This file is too large: at most {{max}}.
attachments.noCamera: The camera is not allowed. Allow it in Settings.
attachments.changed: This file changed since you opened it. Look again, then try once more.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.conflict: Someone decided on this request meanwhile. It now shows as it is.

lock.title: Lock with Face ID or fingerprint
lock.hint: Asks when the app opens, and after a minute away.

unsaved.title: Discard your changes?
unsaved.body: What you changed here is not saved.

mode.read-only: The service is read-only for now: changes are not saved.
